info.title: AcornOps Control Plane API
info.description: Control plane API for workspaces, targets, Kubernetes clusters, virtual machines, sessions, runs, auth, and internal execution wiring.

tags.name: auth
tags.description: OIDC, password, browser session, and external integration account link endpoints.

tags.name: workspaces
tags.description: Workspace, target, Kubernetes cluster, and VM management endpoints.

tags.name: webhooks
tags.description: Best-effort webhook subscription and delivery history endpoints.

tags.name: runs
tags.description: Run query, cancel, and stream endpoints.

tags.name: workflows
tags.description: Workspace workflow definitions, schedules, sessions, and approval inbox endpoints.

tags.name: catalog
tags.description: MCP registries, destination-bound browsing, scoped MCP imports, and personal MCP connections.

tags.name: agents
tags.description: Workspace-scoped custom agent definitions, triggers, versions, tests, and activity.

tags.name: admin
tags.description: Operator-only admin API protected exclusively by admin bearer tokens.

200.description: Admin token id, optional name, scopes, and enabled status.

400.description: Invalid plan or current usage exceeds target plan.

patch.summary: Set or clear workspace quota overrides

200.description: Safe user detail without password hashes or reset tokens.

post.summary: Revoke browser sessions for a user
Emergency rotate a target agent key

200.description: One-time agent key and install instructions.
Paged safe run summaries without prompts or message bodies.
Safe run detail without prompt or full tool argument content.

post.summary: Cancel a run without workspace membership
Break-glass terminalize a stuck run as failed

409.description: Run appears active and force was not set.

get.summary: Search workspace audit events across workspaces

McpReadinessFailure.description: Bounded MCP readiness metadata. Credential, identity, header, URL, and connection snapshot fields are never included.

readinessErrors.description: Compatibility messages retained for older clients.

action.description: Compatibility shortcut for the first failure action.

AgentMutation.description: Agent profile and policy fields only. Install MCP servers and skills through the Agent-scoped capability routes.

WorkspaceInvitationCreated.description: Invitation response. Includes the raw invitation token once.

restrictionMode.description: inherit resolves the selected Agents current combined ceiling. restrict uses semanticCapabilityIds as an explicit subset, including an intentionally empty subset.

semanticCapabilityIds.description: Must be empty when restrictionMode is inherit.

maxRuntimeSeconds.description: Effective deployment-wide execution limit. Workflow mutations cannot override this value.

retentionDays.description: Effective deployment-wide report retention period. Workflow mutations cannot override this value.

summary.description: Human-readable, non-authoritative description of the pending write action.

WebhookCreated.description: Webhook subscription response. Includes signing secret once.

AdminUser.description: Support-safe user detail. Password hashes, reset tokens, and OIDC subjects are never returned.

AdminRun.description: Support-safe run detail without prompts or full tool arguments.

agentKey.description: Returned only by emergency agent-key rotation.
